title: Still Counting
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: Theo always wins hide-and-seek. I learned why.
first_visual: A dark pantry cupboard, door ajar; a small yellow-socked foot pulls back inside.

beats.visual: Dark pantry, door ajar; a small yellow-socked foot pulls back inside.
beats.vo: Theo always wins hide-and-seek. I learned why.

beats.visual: Ivy counts aloud against the fridge, eyes covered, then turns.
She opens the pantry at once: Theo crouched, terrified, finger to his lips.
Silence; Ivy listens; a slow voice from deep in the flat counts on.

beats.vo: He wasn't winning. He's been hiding. Since last winter.

beats.visual: The counting stops (audio beat over held frame of the hallway).
Key moment: Theo pulls Ivy into the pantry; door shuts; two pairs of lamp-lit eyes; a tall shadow passes the crack.

ending: Theo pulls Ivy into the pantry. A tall shadow passes the crack. 'You're in the game now.'
loop_note: Partial. It ends in the pantry; frame 1 is the pantry from outside.

originality_review: Original. A hide-and-seek game that never ended, with a counting entity, is our construction. It is not the 'hide and seek alone' ritual creepypasta: there is no doll and no ritual.
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: Theo has not lost a game of hide-and-seek in a year. Ivy finds him at once because he was not hiding from her. Something else has been counting since last winter, and it has just reached 'ready or not'.

hooks.line: Theo always wins hide-and-seek. I learned why.
hooks.first_visual: A dark pantry cupboard, door ajar; a small yellow-socked foot pulls back inside.
A boy crouched in a pantry, finger to his lips.

hooks.line: Three thousand four hundred and eleven. And counting.
hooks.first_visual: A dark hallway; the voice comes from nowhere.

hooks.line: Nobody has found Theo in a year. I found him in five seconds.
hooks.first_visual: A woman opening a cupboard door instantly.
Two pairs of eyes catching light in a dark cupboard.

setting: Ivy's kitchen and the pantry cupboard; the dark flat beyond.
conflict: Ivy plays a normal game, then has to understand Theo's terror.
escalation: The whisper, the slow counting voice in the flat, then the count stopping.
reveal: Theo has been hiding from something else for a year. 'Ready or not.'
emotional_objective: A childhood game made deadly; protective dread.
